# sprint accounts create

Package: `@hyungjuk/sprint` · Version: `1.1.0`

[CLI index](../../README.md) · [Parent](../accounts.md)

## Help

```text
NAME
  sprint accounts create — create native accounts; server authorization and validation apply

SYNOPSIS
  sprint accounts create --json-data OBJECT | --file PATH --password-file /absolute/private/password.txt [FLAGS]

DESCRIPTION
  create native accounts; server authorization and validation apply

EXAMPLES
  sprint accounts create --file input.json --password-file /absolute/private/password.txt

POSITIONAL ARGUMENTS
  None; see SYNOPSIS for required input flags.

FLAGS
  --password-stdin | --password-file PATH (required; see SYNOPSIS)
  --json-data OBJECT | --file PATH

GLOBAL FLAGS
  --help, -h                 Show command help without authentication or network.
  --schema [DOMAIN]          Print API action contracts as JSON; not CLI flag syntax.
  --llms [DOMAIN]            AI guide; DOMAIN selects action-contract JSON.
  --profile NAME             Select a private Sprint profile (default: default).
  --token-file FILE          Use an owned mode 0600 automation-token JSON file.
  --non-interactive          Never prompt; startup auto-update is skipped.
  --wait                     Observe an accepted job without retrying the mutation.
  --timeout SECONDS          Wait timeout, 1..3600; requires --wait (default: 30).

OUTPUT
  output {data} on stdout; errors on stderr.

AUTHENTICATION
  Sprint profile or automation-token file required. Server permissions are authoritative.

NOTES
  Examples use placeholder IDs and files; replace them with authorized current values.
  Administration uses the same native HTTP APIs as /admin and /org. Account get selects an exact, case-sensitive email from the authenticated collection; there is no detail GET endpoint. Account creation/update accepts email/memberId/level/clevel/disabled/permissions; password is supplied only by --password-stdin or --password-file PATH (owned regular 0600 file, no symlinks). Secret keys in JSON payloads are rejected, including private JSON files. Password-only update may omit JSON. Superadmin transfer is accounts update EMAIL with level=superadmin; the server demotes the previous owner and protects the sole owner. Settings update accepts only quarters/templates/visibility and is superadmin-only. Public invitations get/accept and signups create/status require explicit --base-url and never read the CLI session. Invitation token uses --token-stdin or --token-file PATH (0600); accept uses one token source plus one password source, never two stdin sources. Invitation create requires --output-file PATH: a new exclusive 0600 token-only file, with token masked in stdout URL. No email is sent. No overwrite, symlink output, redirects, remote HTTP, retries, revision or operation-key flags. HTTP 400/410 retain exit 7; 401=4, 403=8, 404=5, 409=9; argument/file errors=64.
  JSON payload: {"email":"email (create)","memberId":"native member ID (create)","level":"member | admin | superadmin (superadmin-only policy)","clevel":"boolean (superadmin-only)","disabled":"boolean","permissions":"resource → access/create/update/delete booleans (superadmin-only)"}

SEE ALSO
  sprint help accounts
  sprint topic output
  Documentation: https://github.com/Hyungjuk42/sprint-docs/blob/main/cli/reference/accounts/create.md
```
